evidence: DNS: bigdata-sea.kr apex NOERROR/no A record; www.bigdata-sea.kr CNAME → slb-1521136.gov-ncloudslb.com which returns NXDOMAIN on local, 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1. TCP connect fails with gaierror on 3 attempts. KMI press coverage describes the 해양수산 빅데이터 플랫폼 project as funded through 2022.
note: Naver Cloud load balancer behind the www CNAME has been deprovisioned; the DNS zone still exists but points nowhere.

evidence: crimestats.or.kr and www.crimestats.or.kr both return NXDOMAIN on all three resolvers; WebFetch fails with ENOTFOUND. curl of https://www.kicj.re.kr/crimestats/portal/openapi/openApiIntroPage.do returns 200 after redirecting to https://www.kicj.re.kr/stats/ (title 'MATRIX :: BI(business Intelligence)').

evidence: www.dpg.go.kr resolves to 139.150.86.87 but port 443 times out on 3 separate attempts from a Korean network and port 80 returns Connection refused; WebFetch from US infrastructure also gets ECONNREFUSED 139.150.86.87:443. MOLEG published a 폐지령안 입법예고 repealing 디지털플랫폼정부위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정, and Seoul Economic Daily reported the committee is being dissolved.
note: Presidential committee abolished under the current administration; no successor portal found (dpghub.go.kr and www.dpghub.go.kr also do not resolve).

evidence: open.eais.go.kr resolves to 59.10.75.217; raw TCP connect to both 443 and 80 times out on 3 attempts from Korea, and WebFetch from US gets ECONNREFUSED. Sibling host www.eais.go.kr accepts TCP on 443 but returns HTTP 307 with a zero-byte body. No migration or shutdown notice found in search; open.eais.go.kr URLs are still actively indexed.
note: Only the open.* subdomain is unreachable while the main 세움터 host answers, so this looks like a server-side outage rather than a decommission.

evidence: https://www.gov.kr/openapi returns HTTP 200 with title '공공서비스 활용 Open API | 정부24'. The probed bare-host form https://gov.kr/openapi returns a 301 whose Location header is malformed, producing the invalid URL http://www.gov.kropenapi/ (missing path separator).
note: Site is fine; the apex-to-www redirect drops the slash and corrupts the path, so the www form must be used.

evidence: https://hf.go.kr/ returns 200 (redirects to /ko/index.do), but every /abc/* path including the probed hf-open-api-webpage returns HTTP 502 and redirects to https://hf.go.kr/error.html. note: Main HF site is healthy; the /abc/ open-API webapp is broken and the API docs now live on the 주택금융통계시스템 (houstat) subdomain.

evidence: onbid.co.kr apex resolves to 59.186.127.193 but no HTTP response (code 000); www.onbid.co.kr resolves to a different IP 61.108.83.195 and returns HTTP 200 with title '온비드'.
note: Apex host is not serving HTTP — the www form is required.

evidence: opinet.co.kr apex has no A record on any of the three resolvers. https://www.opinet.co.kr returns 405 to HEAD but a GET to /user/main/mainView.do returns HTTP 200 with title '싼 주유소 찾기 오피넷'.
note: Apex does not exist in DNS and the server rejects HEAD requests, so probes must use GET against the www host.

evidence: reb.or.kr apex has no A record; www.reb.or.kr returns 403 to HEAD but a GET to /r-one/main.do returns HTTP 200 (109KB) after redirecting to /r-one/portal/main/indexPage.do. The legacy r-one.co.kr domain resolves but does not complete TLS.
note: R-ONE is now hosted under www.reb.or.kr/r-one/; the apex is absent from DNS and the server 403s HEAD requests.

evidence: data.smartfarmkorea.net returns HTTP 503 with a Korean error page reading '연결 오류가 발생했습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도 부탁드립니다. ※ 오류가 지속될 경우, 서버 점검중일 수 있습니다.' The main host www.smartfarmkorea.net returns HTTP 200.
